# Everything Remote Job

> Everything Remote Job (ERJ), by Business Play Ltd, helps professionals in Nigeria and across Africa with real work experience find what is standing between them and a remote job, and fix it, right from where they are. Three ways to work with us: do it yourself, done with you, or done for you. Every way starts free.

## Start here (free)
- [Find what is holding you back](https://everythingremotejob.com/diagnose/): five questions that show which part of a remote job search is breaking (Capacity, Supply, Representation, Aim or Conversion)
- [Capacity Audit](https://everythingremotejob.com/capacityscan/): ten questions on whether you can do the work, scored privately
- [CV Scan](https://everythingremotejob.com/cvscan/): a CV scored against ten points, on your own device
- [Remote Job Board](https://everythingremotejob.com/jobs/): remote roles open to someone living in Nigeria or Africa, checked twice a day
- [The Remote Job Launchpad](https://everythingremotejob.com/masterclass/): a free weekly walkthrough of your CV, every Saturday 4:00 PM WAT, live on Zoom
- [Blog](https://everythingremotejob.com/blog.html): a plain-English post every day on the remote job search

## Go further
- [Remote Job Foundation Training](https://everythingremotejob.com/foundationtraining/): live, marked training with a certificate (done with you)
- [The Self-Learn Pack](https://everythingremotejob.com/selflearn/): the same four stages, self-paced (do it yourself)
- [From Intent to Offer](https://everythingremotejob.com/fromintenttooffer/): the whole method as a book
- [The CV Engine](https://everythingremotejob.com/cvbuilder.html): rebuild a CV against the ten-point rubric
- [Job Application, done for you](https://everythingremotejob.com/jobapplication/): we search and apply on your behalf
- [The Inner Circle](https://everythingremotejob.com/innercircle/): private one-to-one support, by application
- [Every offer and price](https://everythingremotejob.com/register.html)

## Notes
- No placement, timeline or salary is guaranteed.
- "Remote" on its own does not mean open to Nigeria; every role on the job board has been checked for that.
- Contact: the official WhatsApp line, +234 803 292 5957.
